description: 東京都交通局 都営バス・都営地下鉄オープンデータ(公共交通オープンデータセンター提供) [railways and stations and bus and public transit] is a dataset listed in Tokyo Metropolitan Government Open Data Catalog Site (catalog.data.metro.tokyo.lg.jp), an open data portal, published or maintained by 東京都交通局. 【公共交通オープンデータセンターにユーザー登録することでご利用いただけます】 東京都交通局の都営バス、都営地下鉄、東京さくらトラム（都電荒川線）のロケーション情報や時刻表などの情報を、公共交通オープンデータセンターより提供しています。. Coverage: Tokyo, Japan. The portal files it under the publisher 東京都交通局. It offers 17 resource(s) in gtfs, json, pdf. The portal shows 2025-12-12 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is クリエイティブ・コモンズ 表示（CC BY）. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-tokyo-portal.
